description: Returns the current BTC/ETH risk regime (calm | elevated | crash), a severity score and the matching risk posture (risk_on | reduce | risk_off), derived from GBLIN's on-chain Crash Shield against Chainlink oracle peaks on Base. Independent of holding GBLIN. Free by default; a 0.002 USDC charge applies only when the server operator sets MCP_PAYWALL=true.

_payment.description: Base64-encoded x402 PaymentProof JSON. Omit on first call to receive the 402 payment manifest.

name: get_market_risk_regime
